is exactly why I do my best to stay well clear of GP surgeries, but when it comes to children, this is just shocking.

I attended the GP surgery this evening around 5.30pm after my 2-year-old son had a fall at nursery and sustained a small cut to his ear. Nursery staff weren’t overly concerned but suggested seeking a professional opinion from a pharmacist or GP.

I explained to the receptionist at this GP that I was hoping a doctor could take a quick look to advise whether it required any further treatment, as I was trying to avoid attending an already busy A&E department unnecessarily with two very young children.

Unfortunately, the response from reception was very cold and dismissive. I was made to feel like a complete inconvenience for even asking. I was told the doctor was “far too busy catching up with today’s work,” despite the waiting area being empty. I suggested he might need wee butterfly stitches but I was informed they don’t provide butterfly stitches and was directed to A&E, (I understood) however, I simply asked if the doctor could briefly assess the cut.

I was told I could wait while she “checked,” but it was heavily emphasised that this would be an inconvenience. After waiting 20 minutes, I was told the doctor would not look at him and that I should go to A&E,  which, sadly, came as no surprise.

As a parent, I was simply seeking reassurance and trying to avoid putting further strain on emergency services. The lack of compassion and basic warmth from the receptionist was extremely disappointing.

I genuinely don’t understand why anyone would choose to work in this environment if they have no compassion for the people walking through the door. Could clearly see i was a worried parent with 2 young children with me and was made to feel like a total inconvenience.",null,[0,122]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21WWlVtb3pjRE52YzJRd1ZsWmliRXBZT0ZGRFQyYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xcedae2e4fb110e9e!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOmVZUmozcDNvc2QwVlZibEpYOFFDT2c%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21WWlVtb3pjRE52YzJRd1ZsWmliRXBZT0ZGRFQyYxAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwiIhtD3u7CTAxV6d4QGHQZkL5sQoykICigB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwiIhtD3u7CTAxV6d4QGHQZkL5sQ0pMFCAgoAg"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBeHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMDlZVTFndFVWOWZSV2hFVFZwRU4zTlFkVWRrUmtwTGRGUmhORUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpRVVVOWk5XUktaalZCV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2paNFNraFZlSFpJV0daV01YbHZhbVpwWVhKeE5WRRAB",["0x0:0xcedae2e4fb110e9e",null,1767350224773334,1767350224773334,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/112177499435260475411/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["TheTron Burns","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKTGoClNBq2bRoTDy2C_upB2JfLhjm2PNoZ0cF9Vs-xnpJtJA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/112177499435260475411?hl=en"],"112177499435260475411",null,1,0,null,[0,1,1],0,["1 review",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwiIhtD3u7CTAxV6d4QGHQZkL5sQ7LoGCAwoAA"]]]],null,"2 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Phoned the surgery at half past 8 to be told I was 4th in the queue.
